name: Throttles per agent
description:
Shows: Sum of throttles reported by finished runs, per agent: retried throttled calls plus waits on Gemini 503 overloads (overload_wait). Reads run.finished.
Why it matters: Each throttle is a wait of up to a minute: runs slow down and may time out. Check Model retries per day for the reason: throttled means we are pushing rate limits (spread dispatch out or cut calls per run); overload_wait means Gemini is overloaded and only time fixes it.
